user_input: What is the two-hop relationship from LockBit affiliates through Advanced Internet Protocol (IP) Scanner to an ATT&CK technique in this advisory? Explain both the software-use link and the technique mapping.
response:
LockBit affiliates use Advanced IP Scanner to perform network scans. [E2, E3, E1]
Advanced IP Scanner is used for Network Service Discovery (T1046). [E2, E3, E1, E8]
LockBit affiliates may use Advanced Port Scanner to enumerate connected machines in the network. [E5, E3, E1]
Network Service Discovery (T1046) is used by LockBit affiliates. [E5, E8]
Use Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031) to detect and prevent remote service scans. [E10, E11]
